situation: Swiss group, our sole source for the ATEX, drinking-water-approved HI cartridge seal, and its approvals were just extended (moat). Head office has frozen all price reductions until Dec 2027 and the quote says 'discounts not possible this year', but the sales director is open on payment terms and call-off flexibility. We are 0.17 % of its turnover. Its price has not moved in 4 years and carries ~14 % margin over its should-cost. Contract runs to 2026-12-31 with 180 days notice, so it has rolled over by 12 months and no 2027 price change was notified in time.
